title: CySA+ Study Materials
summary: The Cybersecurity Analyst+ certification was one I really enjoyed. The PBQs are applicable and have students tracing malicious network traffic. I studied for this over the course of four months. Many of my study materials are gone, but I can link what I did use. NOTE: It appears that this exam is now the CS0-004, I tested during CS0-003. There may be better resources.
